title: 第6章 新能力、时机已至！
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

——最渴望爱的阿祖倒在了520这天，且被残忍爆头，黑袍最后一集简直拉了一坨大的（为阿祖加更）——

一顿气氛尴尬、心思各异的晚餐后，天色已暗。

阿祖又留恋一会才依依不舍地与儿子亲切告别。

刚出房子，就看到贝卡等在门外。

“母亲时间…”

阿祖作出请进的手势。

贝卡不为所动，只是母狼似的盯着他：“不要再来了！”

阿祖愣了下神：“你，你说什么？”

“我说，以后再也不要来我这里，莱恩是我的儿子，他会过普通人的生活。”

“请你，不要来打扰我们！”

贝卡也是没办法了。

白天她去找了鲍姆博士，可收获的答案却是冷冰冰的一句：等祖国人感到无聊，他就会放过你们。

是的，面对祖国人，沃特公司绝不会选择硬碰硬。

因为他们知道，祖国人无可制约，尤其是在他选择亲手杀死了玛德琳，掐灭人性中母爱的弱点以后。

去他妈的沃特公司，贝卡只想让她的莱恩快乐健康地长大。

阿祖的面皮抽动了一下，火气刚要上来，却又突然被他一把掐断。

白天与莱恩的秘密分享，让他知道了自己儿子已经觉醒了超级听力，这会儿儿子在卧室中说不定就正听着呢。

谁说阿祖没心眼。

一想到此，他立刻就调整了语气和神色，表现得很弱气道：“别这样贝卡，莱恩也是我的儿子，我爱他。”

“当初如果你告诉我他的存在，我绝不会让莱恩没有亲生父亲。”

“我为什么要告诉你，你这个……”

不等贝卡骂出口，阿祖直接打断她：“当初你也很享受啊，我记得你来了三次，哦对了，比利也已经知道了这件事，我告诉过他。”

贝卡一个踉跄，靠在墙上。

阿祖摊手：“另外，贝卡，难道维持这个漂亮的空中楼阁会让你感觉到心安吗？可是莱恩呢，你有没有考虑过他的感受。”

“当他知道自己生活在一个虚假的世界以后，他会怎么想？”

“你，在欺骗他！”

贝卡无言以对。

——Azu, who longed for love the most, fell down on 520, and was brutally headshot. The last episode of Black Robe was a big mess (added update for Azu)——

After an awkward dinner with mixed thoughts, it was already dark.

Azu lingered for a while before reluctantly saying goodbye to his son cordially.

As soon as he left the house, he saw Beca waiting outside the door.

“Mother time…”

Azu made a gesture to invite him in.

Beka remained unmoved, just stared at him like a she-wolf: "Don't come again!"

Azu was stunned for a moment: "You, what did you say?"

"I said, never come to my place again. Ryan is my son and he will live an ordinary life."

"Please, don't disturb us!"

Beca was helpless.

During the day, she went to see Dr. Baum, but the answer she received was a cold one: When the people of the motherland get bored, he will let you go.

Yes, in the face of the people of the motherland, Watt Company will never choose to go head-on.

Because they knew that the people of the motherland could not be restrained, especially after he chose to kill Madeline with his own hands and eliminate the weakness of maternal love in human nature.

Fuck Vought, Beca just wants her Ryan to grow up happy and healthy.

Azu's face twitched, and just as he was about to get angry, he suddenly cut him off.

The secret shared with Ryan during the day made him know that his son had awakened super hearing, and his son might be listening in the bedroom at this moment.

Who said Azu was heartless.

When he thought of this, he immediately adjusted his tone and expression, and said weakly: "Don't be like this, Beka, Ryan is also my son, and I love him."

"If you had told me of his existence, I would never have left Ryan without his biological father."

"Why should I tell you, you..."

Before Beka could curse, Azu interrupted her directly: "You enjoyed it a lot back then. I remember you came three times. Oh, by the way, Billy already knew about it. I told him."

Beca stumbled and leaned against the wall.

Azu spread his hands: "Besides, Beka, will maintaining this beautiful castle in the air make you feel at ease? But as for Ryan, have you ever considered his feelings?"

"What will he think when he knows he lives in a false world?"

"You are deceiving him!"

Beca was speechless.
